mapper.select: /* Attd05Mapper.selectDayList */ WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS ( SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(REPLACE(#{workYm}, '-', ''), '01'), '%Y%m%d') AS dt UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_range WHERE DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) <= LAST_DAY(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(REPLACE(#{workYm}, '-', ''), '01'), '%Y%m%d')) ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.dt, '%Y%m%d') AS workYmd , CASE DAYOFWEEK(d.dt) WHEN 1 THEN '일' WHEN 2 THEN '월' WHEN 3 THEN '화' WHEN 4 THEN '수' WHEN 5 THEN '목' WHEN 6 THEN '금' WHEN 7 THEN '토' END dow , CASE WHEN h.HOLIDAY_YMD IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS holidayYn , h.HOLIDAY_NM AS holidayNm , h.HOLIDAY_TYPE AS holidayType , CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(d.dt) IN (1, 7) -- 1:일요일, 7:토요일 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS weekendYn FROM date_range d LEFT JOIN TB_HOLIDAY h ON h.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND h.HOLIDAY_YMD = d.dt AND h.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* Attd05Mapper.selectSchList */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.SCH_CD AS schCd , A.SCH_NO AS schNo , CASE WHEN SCH_TYPE = '01' THEN CONCAT( SUBSTRING(A.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, 1, 2), ':' , SUBSTRING(A.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, 3, 2), '~' , SUBSTRING(A.FST_SCH_END_TIME, 1, 2), ':' , SUBSTRING(A.FST_SCH_END_TIME, 3, 2)) ELSE CONCAT( SUBSTRING(A.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, 1, 2), ':' , SUBSTRING(A.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, 3, 2), '~' , SUBSTRING(A.FST_SCH_END_TIME, 1, 2), ':' , SUBSTRING(A.FST_SCH_END_TIME, 3, 2), '\n' , SUBSTRING(A.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, 1, 2), ':' , SUBSTRING(A.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, 3, 2), '~' , SUBSTRING(A.SEC_SCH_END_TIME, 1, 2), ':' , SUBSTRING(A.SEC_SCH_END_TIME, 3, 2) ) END schNm FROM TB_SCH_MGMT A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd}
/* Attd05Mapper.selectLeaveTypeList */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnoyCd , A.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , A.LEAVE_NO AS leaveNo , A.LEAVE_NM AS leaveNm FROM TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd}
